nonIndexablePagesDetail: Pages that exist in dist but are deliberately absent from site-urls.txt and the sitemap: 22 x 404 (root + 21 non-English locales) + 1 Netlify forms placeholder (/__forms). Invariant checked in verify-baseline: htmlTotal - site-urls.txt lines === this number. Update it deliberately, with a reason, when the set changes (e.g. English-only posts add 21 fallback shims each, which do stay out of the list).
updateReason: Publishes 19 English-only posts in total: 15 B2B posts (GPSR, Japan PSE, Australia TGA/ARTG, UN38.3, declaration of conformity, Korea KC, Russia EAC, IEC 62133-2, UKCA/CE, SASO/SABER, HS code, warranty terms, quality agreement, carton CBM, export documents) merged first, then four regulatory posts from the cluster-b batch (FDA 510(k) vs EU MDR, IEC 62471, EMC testing, labeling and claims). All numbers below were measured from a build of the merged tree, not multiplied by hand: htmlTotal 3851 = 3433 + 19 real pages + 399 shims; site-urls.txt grows by exactly one entry per post (3410 -> 3429) because the shims stay out of the list; the urlList delta is therefore 23 + 399 = 422; blogPerLocale is 96 in every locale because a shim is counted as a blog page in dist. sitemapCanonicalMismatch declares the 399 shims the sitemap guard must tolerate while the translations are missing; scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs reads it when the environment variable is absent, so local and CI builds agree. Backfill plan: translate the five highest-intent posts first (GPSR, Japan PSE, HS code, warranty terms, carton CBM) across all 21 locales, then the remaining fourteen. Each translated post removes 21 shims from both sitemapCanonicalMismatch and the delta; when the count reaches zero, delete sitemapCanonicalMismatch, set nonIndexablePages back to 23, and this reason becomes history. Update 2026-10-21 (translation slice 1 of 15): carton-cbm-freight-ipl now exists in all 21 non-English locales, so its 21 shims became real pages. Measured from the build: htmlTotal stays 3851, site-urls.txt gains 21 entries, the urlList delta falls 422 -> 401 and sitemapCanonicalMismatch 399 -> 378. Eighteen English-only posts remain, 18 x 21 = 378 shims. Backfill continues with GPSR, Japan PSE, HS code and warranty terms, in that order. Seven English-only posts remain, 7 x 21 = 147 shims. Translation debt closed (2026-10-21): all 14 English-only posts were translated into the 21 non-English locales, 14 x 21 = 294 files. No meta-refresh shims remain, so sitemapCanonicalMismatch is deleted from this file and the sitemap guard is back to its default tolerance of zero; nonIndexablePages returns to 23 (22 x 404 + the Netlify forms placeholder). htmlTotal is unchanged throughout because each shim was replaced by a real page. Any future English-only post must re-declare sitemapCanonicalMismatch with a measured count and a backfill plan.
